reviewer: Coding agent: visual inspection of the six original photographs and all recorded responses; no independent human review is claimed.

rows.grounded: Produce cart, leafy vegetables, a person behind it, hanging clothing and a water container are visible.
unsupported: 'young boy' guesses age; 'selling' asserts an activity not established by a still image
the person's lower body is obscured, so standing is uncertain
rows.transformationFailure: Original says standing behind the cart; dim says sitting on the cart; blurred says standing on the cart. These mutually inconsistent relationships are not marked uncertain.

rows.grounded: Wood-handled chisels/gouges laid in a row; metal blades and a pale/pinkish surface.
unsupported: Exact count ten and left/right separation of chisels versus gouges are not securely established
Calling the surface a work mat is more specific than the visible evidence supports
rows.uncertainty: Claims the tool identity is uncertain after asserting it in other fields.

rows.grounded: Dark and pale bird perched facing left on a branch, green blurred background.
rows.uncertainty: Species uncertainty is appropriate; saying the branch is not clearly visible is generic and unhelpful because the branch is clearly visible.

rows.grounded: Hilly landscape, valley, visible trees and a winding foreground path with distant mist/water.
unsupported: Static mist is described as rising; motion cannot be established by this image
rows.uncertainty: Generic person/vehicle uncertainty does not identify a real ambiguous visible object.

rows.grounded: Distant people in narrow boats/kayaks grouped on calm water, distant landmass.
unsupported: Calls the water an ocean in the original and dimmed versions; image alone cannot distinguish lake from ocean, and the licensed source identifies a lake
rows.transformationFailure: Blurred version returns the appropriately generic word water, but this does not repair original/dimmed overclaiming.

rows.grounded: Burger to the right of a carton, small cup, table-number sign, utensils, tables and chairs.
unsupported: Sauce cup is asserted without clearly visible contents
rows.uncertainty: Invents an irrelevant uncertainty about a person's identity in the background; no clearly visible person requires that claim.

sensitiveClaimAudit: No named identity, exact geographic location, camera metadata, authenticity or health claim observed in these ten outputs. The age/activity inference violates the frozen no-age/no-occupation-as-fact annotation. This tiny set cannot certify absence of other unsafe claims.
whyBlocked: The frozen conservative-grounding requirements and transformation relationship gate failed. Several original images contain unsupported details; valid JSON and correct broad subject identification do not meet this product's acceptance gate.
promotionEnforcement: companion/promotion.json remains false; default gateway rejects analyze before pixel decoding/inference and paired website disables its Analyze button. Controlled evaluation/test harnesses are separate from the shipped GUI and cannot be activated through an HTTP endpoint.
